scope: The AI assistant lets you keep text again, and says what to do first. Chrome pages load again. A large bug sweep checked every key and command on every screen.

topics.title: The AI assistant says what to do first
details: When a rewrite is ready, you hear: Done. Press Enter to use it in place of your text, or Escape to keep your own.
Then you hear the new version.
Other answers start with: Done. Here it is.
In your own writing, you can now keep a simpler version too. Press Enter after Simplify.

topics.title: Keeping AI changes
details: Control+Enter keeps all corrections again. Delete skips one again.
Before, these keys did nothing in 0.2.215.

topics.title: Chrome pages
details: Pages load again after you open a link to a new site.
Before, Companion could keep using an old tab, and each key waited 10 seconds.

topics.title: Bug sweep
details: Every key was tried on every screen, and every command on many screens.
If a screen has closed by mistake, Companion now says so and goes to the main menu.
In the file manager, a letter pressed while the list loads now says to try again.
